SAMPLE — FICTIONAL DOCUMENT FOR PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION ONLY

SAMPLE REFINERY LTD. — INSPECTION DEPARTMENT
INSPECTION REPORT No. IR-2026-118

Date of inspection: 14-10-2026 Unit: Crude Distillation Unit
Equipment: Crude charge pump P-2105B (Criticality: C)

Inspected by: Condition Monitoring Engineer

1. Vibration readings (mm/s RMS)

Location Horizontal Vertical Axial
DE bearing 6.4 4.1 3.2
NDE bearing yal 3.6 PAT

2. Bearing housing temperature

Location Previous (14-09-2026) Current
DE bearing 68 °C 86 °C
NDE bearing 65 °C 714°C

3. Observations

a) Highest vibration 6.4 mm/s at DE horizontal. Spectrum shows
peaks at bearing defect frequencies, indicating DE bearing wear.

b) DE bearing temperature rose by 18 °C since the last reading.

c) Oil level normal. Oil sample slightly darkened.

d) Coupling alignment not checked (pump in service).

Page 1 of 2

SAMPLE — FICTIONAL DOCUMENT FOR PROTOTYPE DEMONSTRATION ONLY
INSPECTION REPORT No. IR-2026-118 (continued)

4. Recommendations

1) Change over to standby pump P-2105A after confirming its
condition, and replace DE and NDE bearings of P-2105B.

2) Carry out laser alignment of pump and motor after bearing job.

3) Replace lubricating oil and send old oil for analysis.

4) Increase vibration monitoring of P-2105B to weekly until

readings return to Zone B or better.

5. Estimated cost

Item Amount (Rs)
Bearings (1 set, DE + NDE) 65,000

Laser alignment + labour 48,000

Lubricating oil + analysis 12,000

Total 1,25,000
Condition Monitoring Engineer Area Maintenance Engineer
(signed) (signed)

Page 2 of 2
